applicabilityBasis.summary: ctUSD is a MoonPay-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin using M0 infrastructure with 1:1 mint and redemption.

genius.licensingRegulator: MoonPay USA LLC: NYDFS BitLicense and Money Transmitter License plus other state MTLs; MoonPay Trust Company, LLC separately holds the NY limited-purpose trust charter; potential GENIUS pathway undeclared
genius.notes: MoonPay positions ctUSD as 'designed to align with the forthcoming GENIUS Act guidelines' (Citrea launch blog, Jan 2026) and MoonPay VP Harrison described GENIUS as a regulatory 'permission slip' at Consensus Miami 2026 (May 8, 2026). No token-specific PPSI application, state-qualified approval, or OCC/FDIC filing was found as of 2026-06-18. The application framework remains in NPRM stage. MoonPay USA LLC holds the NYDFS BitLicense and New York Money Transmitter License plus money-transmission licenses in other U.S. jurisdictions; MoonPay Trust Company, LLC separately holds the NY limited-purpose trust charter for custody and OTC trading. No GENIUS pathway has been publicly declared.
